prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works tabletop UI pictogram: ONE big soft teardrop-shaped wisp of glowing emerald green magical flame-light rising upward, a bright pale core, two tiny sparks of the same colour beside it, floating alone: an aura of this colour. Dominant subject colour key: glowing emerald green; the whole wisp is this colour, strongly visible, not just an accent. Heroic hand-painted style D, chunky matte painted forms, broad soft bevels, restrained brushwork. Centered on a dark charcoal circular ground, quiet thin slate rim. Upper-left light. Straight-on circular badge; outer circle fills 94 percent of square canvas, pictogram fills 80 percent of disc. Readable at 31px and smaller: bold silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, absolutely no tiny detail. Native transparent alpha outside the circle. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative flourishes or extra scene. Our own design, no trademarked game iconography. Style reference: the attached images are our own earlier Turnip Works ring icons from this same set; match their circular ground, rim, painted brushwork, bevels, lighting and palette exactly, as if painted by the same artist in the same sitting. Do not copy their subjects. No third-party references.
